title: When Diffusion Recommenders Stop Sampling: Preserving Generative Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2610.36954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A user history can admit multiple plausible next interactions, yet conventional sequential recommenders produce a single deterministic ranking. While diffusion models offer a natural way to sample alternative continuations, we show that existing target-item diffusion recommenders often suffer from severe sampling collapse, producing nearly identical outputs across independent draws. We identify two ubiquitous design choices that promote this collapse: joint learning of the latent space and denoiser, and in-trajectory supervision via discrete losses. To address these failure modes, we introduce DARTS (Diverse and Accurate Recommendation Through Sampling), a three-stage latent diffusion framework that explicitly decouples representation learning, generative modeling, and discrete ranking by learning and freezing the latent space before diffusion training and postponing ranking supervision to the final decoding stage. translated_title: 当扩散推荐器停止采样时：保持生成多样性
translated_abstract: 用户的交互历史可能存在多种合理的下一次交互，然而传统的序列推荐器只产生单一确定性排序。虽然扩散模型提供了一种自然的采样替代延续的方式，但我们发现现有的目标物品扩散推荐器往往遭受严重的采样坍塌问题，在多次独立采样时产生几乎相同的输出。我们识别出两种导致这种坍塌的普遍设计选择：隐空间与去噪器的联合学习，以及通过离散损失进行的轨迹内监督。为了解决这些失效模式，我们提出了DARTS（通过采样实现多样且准确的推荐），这是一个三阶段潜在扩散框架，通过在扩散训练之前学习并冻结隐空间，以及将排序监督延迟到最终解码阶段，显式地解耦了表示学习、生成建模和离散排序。
tldr: 该论文发现目标物品扩散推荐器存在严重采样坍塌问题（源于隐空间与去噪器联合学习以及轨迹内离散损失监督两种设计缺陷），并提出三阶段潜在扩散框架DARTS，通过解耦表示学习、生成建模与离散排序，在保持推荐准确性的同时保留了生成多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that target-item diffusion recommenders suffer from severe sampling collapse caused by joint latent-denoiser learning and in-trajectory discrete supervision, and proposes DARTS, a three-stage latent diffusion framework that decouples representation learning, generative modeling, and ranking to preserve generative diversity while maintaining recommendation accuracy.
